## Terraform Resource: kestra_flow

Manages a Kestra Flow.

The flow `description`, `disabled` and `labels` can be written in `content` or set as attributes, but not both. An attribute is merged into the source sent to Kestra and left out of `content` when read back.

## Example usage

```hcl
resource "kestra_flow" "example" {
  namespace = "company.team"
  flow_id   = "my-flow"
  content   = <<EOT
id: my-flow
namespace: company.team
inputs:
  - id: my-value
    type: STRING

variables:
  first: "1"

tasks:
  - id: t2
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.log.Log
    message: first {{task.id}}
    level: TRACE

pluginDefaults:
  - type: io.kestra.plugin.core.log.Log
    values:
      message: third {{flow.id}}
EOT
}

resource "kestra_flow" "with_metadata" {
  namespace   = "company.team"
  flow_id     = "my-other-flow"
  description = "Managed from Terraform"
  disabled    = false
  labels = {
    team = "data"
  }
  content = <<EOT
id: my-other-flow
namespace: company.team
tasks:
  - id: hello
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.log.Log
    message: hello
EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The flow full content in yaml string.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The flow description. Leave `description` out of `content` when set.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the flow is disabled. Leave `disabled` out of `content` when set.
- `flow_id` (String) The flow id. Defaults to the `id` in `content`, which it must match. When `content` leaves `id` out, it is added from this attribute. Set it when `content` can be unknown during planning, or an update of the flow plans a replacement.
- `labels` (Map of String) The flow labels. Leave `labels` out of `content` when set.
- `namespace` (String) The flow namespace. Defaults to the `namespace` in `content`, which it must match. When `content` leaves `namespace` out, it is added from this attribute. Set it when `content` can be unknown during planning, or an update of the flow plans a replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The flow resource id, `namespace/flow_id`.
- `revision` (Number) The flow revision.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import kestra_flow.example {{namespace}}/{{flow_id}}
```
